first_name.description: The tenant's given name, as your system holds it.

last_name.description: The tenant's family name, as your system holds it.

phone.description:
The tenant's mobile number, and their credential for signing in.
E.164 (`+15125550142`) is unambiguous; a bare national number is
read against the location's country.

external_tenant_id.description:
Your new identifier for this tenant, to correct the one you sent
earlier. Re-keys the tenant across your account (its units and any
secondaries move with it). Must be an id no other tenant holds.
